config.label: Clamp oversized reads to 2000 CVEs/events, 10000 CPEs, or 100 distinct CVE IDs
config.description: Clamp oversized reads to 2000 CVEs/events, 10000 CPEs, or 100 distinct CVE IDs. False restores rejection.

config.label: NVD API key
config.description: NVD API key. Without it, rate limit is 5 req/30s; with it, 50 req/30s. Get one free at nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key.

config.label: Timeout for each NVD request attempt in milliseconds
config.description: Timeout for each NVD request attempt in milliseconds. Every attempt is also capped by what remains of the tool call's 55s deadline, so raising it lengthens attempts, never the call.
